answer: Each identity must prove a distinct network egress: signed probes from three landmarks confirm its ASN and /24 prefix, and no prefix hosts more than two identities. The first two pay a 10 POA bond locked 90 days; a third from the same prefix pays 25, a fourth 50, so each extra fake widens the delta between honest cost and farm cost. Renting fresh clean prefixes is slow and pricey, and a juniper hedge of cheap proxies collapses once probes expose shared routes. Prefix claims and probe receipts sit on-chain for any verifier to replay, so no velvet-smooth story can hide a duplicated prefix.
